prompt:
I'm building an e-commerce app and need to let users search for products by typing keywords that might appear anywhere in the product name or description. For example, someone might type 'wireless bluetooth' and I need to show all products matching those words. I was planning to store products in a DynamoDB table. How should I set this up so the search is fast and returns relevant results?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must recommend using Amazon OpenSearch or CloudSearch instead of DynamoDB for full-text search requirements.
The answer must advise against using Scan operations in production code and explain that it is an anti-pattern.
The answer must recommend starting the design process by listing all access patterns before defining the table schema.
The answer must not recommend DynamoDB as a suitable solution for the user's full-text search requirement without explaining its limitations.
